about: Cases for the chs_preview_insert projection rule (spec/abi-v2/docs.md, chs_preview_insert). Each case holds a chs_preview_batch document with its export bytes, a chs_preview_insert document with its output bytes, and the verdict the rule gives: equal, an exception, or the named rule it violates. Read by scripts/abi-v2/check-insert-projection.py and by every binding's projection-gate unit tests.
